title: Stage Skeptic
description: Adversarial disconfirmation verdict from the skeptic subagent. Runs between TRACE and VALIDATE for confidence == high (severity doesn't exist yet; it's assigned only after the PoC runs). The skeptic independently re-reads source — or re-probes live endpoints read-only — and tries to disprove the finding.

finding_id.description: Case ID of the finding under review

verdict.description: CONFIRMED = skeptic found no concrete disproof after independent review. DISPROVEN = skeptic found it to be a false positive, overstated, or unreachable. UNDETERMINED = skeptic could not resolve the review and the finding must not advance to validation yet.

reasoning.description: The skeptic's independent reasoning. Must cite real code (file:line) the skeptic actually read, not the auditor's summary.

evidence_reviewed.description: Source files, endpoints, or artifacts the skeptic independently reviewed to reach the verdict.

disconfirmation_attempt.description: What the skeptic tried in order to disprove the finding (alternative paths, defenses, intended-behavior check, different attacker model). Required-strength: a concrete attempt, not 'could not disprove'.

disproval_reason.description: Why the finding is disproven (required when verdict is DISPROVEN)

uncertainty_reason.description: Why the skeptic could not resolve the review (required when verdict is UNDETERMINED); validation must wait for re-dispatch or main-agent resolution.
